title: China Minmetals Non-ferrous Metals Company Limited - proposed acquisition of OZ Minerals Limited
acquirers: China Minmetals Non-ferrous Metals Company Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: China Minmetals Non-ferrous Metals Company Limited (China Minmetals) entered into an agreement with OZ Minerals Limited (OZ Minerals) whereby Minmetals would acquire all outstanding shares in OZ Minerals.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the effect of the proposed acquisition on national markets for the production and supply of zinc concentrate and copper concentrate.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the markets for the production and supply of either zinc concentrate or copper concentrate, for the following reasons: - There were no areas of domestic competitive overlap between China Minmetals, or its related bodies corporate, and OZ Minerals that were considered to raise concerns. - The zinc market is not particularly concentrated and there are a number of alternative suppliers of zinc concentrate.  As such, it is unlikely that China Minmetals would be able to restrict the supply of zinc concentrate post acquisition. - There are a number of other significant domestic producers of copper concentrate that would be likely to restrain China Minmetals from raising the price or reducing the supply of copper concentrate post acquisition.
